whats_new:
- Added: IntraMind now remembers the results of your previous question within a conversation, so follow-up questions like "and last month?" or "just the top 5" work without repeating context. A New Chat button resets the conversation when you want a fresh start.
- Fixed: folder-based questions (e.g. "items in my Rentals folder") could silently return zero results due to a matching bug in how folder paths were compared.
- Fixed: fiscal-year-based questions ("this fiscal year," "last fiscal year") could compute the wrong date range depending on which month your fiscal year starts in.
- Fixed: "total sales" could give a different number for the identical question depending on how it was phrased.
- Fixed: warehouse-related inventory questions could recommend the wrong warehouse, or fail to match a warehouse referenced by name instead of its code.
- Fixed: searching by a full name (e.g. "John Smith") no longer matches on just one of the words.
- Fixed: year-over-year follow-up questions could reuse the wrong date window from a previous question.
- Fixed: inventory questions about a negative on-hand quantity could produce an explanation not actually supported by the data.
- Fixed: some legitimate questions were being refused, and custom fields weren't always used when relevant.
- Fixed: the New Chat button didn't work from the Dashboard, and follow-up suggestion chips could disappear permanently after their first use.
- Fixed: the What's New dialog could stretch full-screen when the changelog was long.
- Closed a permission gap where roughly 20 tables weren't mapped to any module, which could let a user query data outside their assigned EBMS module permissions.
- Various smaller query-generation fixes surfaced by customer feedback (abbreviated terms, incomplete date periods, category/folder keyword matching).
